question: Can Rune reach trustworthy hotel-comparison quality using browser DOM/accessibility control rather than screenshot-coordinate desktop control?
conclusion_ko: NOL의 텍스트·가격·조건 비교는 DOM 중심 브라우저 조작으로 개선할 근거가 있다. 현재 한계는 평탄화된 관측과 객실/요금제/조건의 의미 연결 및 완료 검증에 있다. 이미지 의미가 필요한 과제에는 같은 브라우저의 시각 관측을 추가하고, OS/네이티브 화면에만 데스크톱 제어를 적용한다. 어느 방식도 임의 사이트에서 한 번에 완벽한 수행을 보장한다는 연구 근거는 없다.

interface_dimensions.warning: A browser can use visual observations without OS-wide control. A screenshot-only observation experiment using DOM-generated element IDs is not a pure coordinate-only desktop agent comparison.

sources.title: WebMall — A Multi-Shop Benchmark for Evaluating Web Agents
sources.scope: 91 tasks, four simulated English electronics shops, two backend models in v3, 50 steps per task. The end-to-end subgroup has eight tasks.
sources.inference: Structured browser observations can be competitive or superior on comparison shopping. Adding images is task/model dependent, not a universal quality upgrade.
sources.counterevidence: Images improved GPT-5.4 end-to-end relative to AX alone. Screenshot-only GPT-5.4 used fewer average input tokens than AX alone (119,866 vs 148,250), despite weaker completion. Do not assert DOM always costs less.
sources.limits: Model-specific observation ablation, not NOL, hotel policy semantics, live login or proof of commercial reliability. v2 and v3 results must not be mixed.

sources.title: WebMall project setup
sources.finding: The authors describe screenshot annotations with numbers corresponding to AX-tree element IDs. Screenshot-based rows therefore should not be labelled as raw-pixel OS computer-use agents.

sources.title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visually Grounded Web Tasks
sources.evidence_type: older foundational counterexample; not current-model ceiling
sources.finding: 910 deliberately visually grounded tasks. Strong visual models outperform text-only baselines for image/OCR/spatial cases.
sources.inference: Room-photo similarity, image-only promotions and map appearance may require visual input. This does not require moving all web interaction to desktop coordinates.
sources.limits: Older GPT-4/GPT-4V-class models, different capabilities, visual task selection; not a controlled estimate of NOL performance.

sources.title: The BrowserGym Ecosystem for Web Agent Research
sources.finding: DOM/AXTree, stable element IDs, visibility, bounding boxes and screenshots are separate configurable observations/actions; reproducibility and live-web variability matter.
sources.limits: Do not use its headline model scores as a clean DOM-versus-vision ablation: experimental prose and appendix settings differ about screenshot availability.

sources.title: OpenAI Computer use integration recipes
sources.evidence_type: official integration guidance, not performance evidence or disclosure of all production internals
sources.finding: Existing function/MCP tools can operate a browser without the built-in computer tool. Locator actions, page text, DOM inspection and screenshots can be combined. Compare success, latency, turns and recovery.

sources.title: WebArena-Verified evaluation documentation
sources.finding: Structured agent response checks and network-event checks are separate from the action driver; exact typed comparison replaces permissive matching.
sources.inference: Rune should validate a rate-specific business result rather than only the presence of source quotes.
sources.limits: Reference answers/backends are available in the benchmark; closed NOL does not expose equivalent ground truth. A separate LLM judge is not a proof of correctness.

sources.title: BrowserArena: Evaluating LLM Agents on Real-World Web Navigation Tasks
sources.finding: 109 user-submitted live tasks; recurring popup, URL-navigation and access-challenge failures, with human/automated-judge disagreement.
sources.limits: BrowserUse-specific observational failure analysis, not a DOM/vision causal comparison. Access restrictions are blockers, not signals to bypass them.

local_evidence.interpretation: The higher displayed amount is explicitly struck through in HTML. Flattening body.inner_text loses this distinction. It is not proof of an available unconditional rate. DOM-based capture could preserve this information without screenshot coordinates.
local_evidence.scope: Offline inspection of a prior real NOL room-list capture, not a new live quote or purchase check.

local_evidence.finding: Final two NOL trials passed exact-quote provenance for 27 fields per trial within standard budget. No modality A/B trial has been run, and full fee/cancellation semantics or member-price eligibility were not proven.

record enforces property ownership, freshness, room/price presence and /list source, but page-wide co-occurrence does not establish that a cancellation/discount span belongs to the selected rate card.

decisions: Keep DOM/AXTree as the primary NOL interface; preserve element hierarchy, room/rate-card identity, visible labels and price styling instead of only body text.

Bind each quote to property, room, rate plan, dates, guests and the actually opened policy details. Preserve old price, member/coupon price, current payable price and unknown eligibility as distinct values.
Treat missing or ambiguous policy applicability as incomplete; source-hash/quote identity is necessary but does not prove policy meaning or full coverage.

Add visual observation within the same browser only when there is a demonstrated visual evidence gap; keep locator actions where the target can be grounded. Desktop control is for native apps or OS dialogs.

Evaluate enriched DOM, enriched DOM plus on-demand vision, and optionally a screenshot-coordinate browser arm with the same model, budgets and task set. Do not conflate model/tool changes with modality effects.

proposed_evaluation.status: proposal only; not executed in this research turn
tasks: multiple dates, lengths of stay, guest counts and rooms
conditional member/coupon rates and undiscounted rates
free/nonrefundable/partially refundable policies and regional taxes
sold-out rooms, delayed rendering, popup and access-blocked cases
metrics: correct completed comparisons over all requests
latency, token cost, rerenders/revisits and visual fallback frequency
proposed_evaluation.method: First regression-test saved adversarial DOM cases, then repeat held-out live cases across cities/date ranges. Review against actual selected rate/policy pages with a human-checked rubric, not a single same-model self-grade. Report all failures and uncertainty; 2/2 is not a reliability estimate.

research_harness.limitation: The bounded research-agent run hit its token admission limit after repeatedly fetching truncated long sources and did not produce a completed audit. It is not counted as corroborating successful analysis. Root separately read the primary WebMall table/setup, VisualWebArena results, official OpenAI guidance and evaluation docs via web browsing; final conclusions are grounded in those checked passages.

scope: Research only. No new NOL live comparison, no browser/desktop A/B experiment, no runtime behavior changes.
